text_block_list.text:
After the winning concert, Смарт Фалкон
meets up
with the fan she made the
promise to.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Heeey, what did you think of the
concert?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: It was amazing! Just amazing! Really... Thank you sooo much!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text: Haha! ☆ Thank you for the support! ♪ And this person next to you must be...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Right! This is the friend I mentioned.
She's feeling
much better now!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, it's the actual Falco! Your concert was i-i-incredible!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! ☆ If you're ever feeling
down
again, don't hesitate to come and
watch me
perform!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Definitely! I'll come as many times as I
can!
P-please let me do something to
thank you for
today!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
And so, Смарт Фалкон's fans take us to a
ramen
shop.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoa! You own a ramen shop?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I had an idea for a new recipe when I was

watching your concert. I want you to try
it!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my concert inspired a new ramen
recipe?!
How does that even happen?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: She's been struggling to come up with a new recipe for so long... I'm so... so glad she finally did iiiit! Sniff!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
The best way to see how you inspired
this recipe
is to try it! Here you go—I call
it Umadol ☆
Ramen!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text: Wow, it looks super tasty! Here goes! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
(I can taste the umami of the crab within
the rich
miso, and the butter conceals a
fluffy milk aroma
which permeates the
dish!)
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It has such a gentle flavor. ☆ It's so
good, I need
to be careful not to stuff
my face! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I made sure each ingredient shines
brightly, just
like a winning concert! The
flavors all work
together to elevate each
other, just like
Umamusume as they aim
for the center position!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Amazing! It really is Umadol ☆
Ramen! ♪ I love it!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so, Смарт Фалкон's fans take us to a
place
with a view of the city.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! This view is fantastic! What a
lovely
spot! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, this is my favorite view in the
area! I
figured this would be a great
place for the
unveiling!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
With that, the fan unfurls a large
homemade
banner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Falco!" Wow! You've
really made
my day!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I made it using the same dyeing
techniques as our
local products. I'd like
to get a job making this
kind of thing...
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text: It looks like you've given her the courage she needed to take this first stЭпизод.. I-I'm so glad she can chase after her dreeeam! Sniff!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry it took so long to show you... I
really
wanted to finish it in time for your
concert.
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Don't say that! It's totally in time! The
concert is
just about to start! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
What?! But you must be exhausted! And
there's
no equipment here or anything...
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
No problem! ♪ Anywhere an Umadol
sings and
dances becomes a stage!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so, Смарт Фалкон's fans take us to
the plaza
outside the train station.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! So many people! I guess it gets
really
packed after a race.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yes... Today is particularly busy, so I
thought I'd
perform here!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait... do you mean?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She wants to be an idol too! You gave
her the
courage to take a step towards
achieving her
dream!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
E-erm... Do you have any advice for
someone
about to take the stage for the
first time?
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... The feeling when you
step onto
your first stage is one that
you'll treasure forever.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Which is to say... um... Ehehe, trying to
sound
cool is kinda hard. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I only have one piece of advice!
Go out
there and have a great time!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'll be watching from the very front! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Wow... thank you so much, Falco! That's
why I
love you so much!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
And so, Смарт Фалкон's fans take us to a
nearby
underpass.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's so peaceful here! ♪ ...Hm?
Where did
they disappear to?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hellooo! We're da Kansai Sisters!
Remember the
name when ya leave!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what's going on?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ya know, I just looove Umadols these
days.
Playing dress-up and havin' a little
tea party with
'em really brings me back
to when I was a little
girl!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Hold up... I don't think you're talkin'
'bout
"Umadols." Ya mean "Uma dolls,"
dummy!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! ☆ That's so funny! Are you two
a
comedy act?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We used to do comedy routines at our
school
festivals! We'd given it up, but...
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Seeing you gave us the courage to start
again.
Now we're aiming to become
professional
comedians!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
That's right! Could you give us some
wisdom
about how to mentally prepare
ourselves to go
out on stage?
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Okay, allow me to share a little
insight
into what I've learned up until
now. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so, Смарт Фалкон's fans guide us to a
quaint
cafe.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a fancy cafe! I'd come here
every day
if I lived in this
neighborhood. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Actually, she owns this cafe! But sales
have been
poor, so she was considering
closing it down...
text_block_list.name: Female Fan A

text_block_list.text:
You gave me the courage to give it one
more
shot, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
For real?! I'm really glad to hear that! It's
a lovely
cafe, so I really hope you keep
it going! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Take one of these desserts by
way of
thanks! I made the donuts in your
likeness!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It looks just like me! The bow
decoration is
super cute too!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna share a pic on Umatter. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Wow, check it out! ♪ Everyone is saying
they
wanna try your donuts!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
R-really?! I'd love it if everyone could
try them...
text_block_list.name: Female Fan B

text_block_list.text:
You'll make a killing if you market them
well! You
can give them the official
Falco seal of approval.
Call them "Falco
Donuts" or something! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Falco Donuts become a hot
item and
the cafe sees a sudden rise in
customers!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by warm-hearted fans, Smart
Falcon
performs on her second "stage"
of the day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон chats away with her fans
while
enjoying the delicious ramen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон passes down her advice on
mentally
preparing for shows to her fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so Смарт Фалкон watches her fan's
debut
performance, cheering for her
louder than
anyone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
